name: kartograph
description: Explore a person's intent into intents/<date>-<slug>.md, extract its concepts into an Open Knowledge Format bundle at knowledge/, and derive capabilities and Gherkin features under features/.

interface.shortDescription: Draw out what a person really wants before anything gets built
interface.longDescription: Kartograph has three skills that build on each other through plain files. kartograph-explore runs one exploring conversation with you and writes intents/<date>-<slug>.md. kartograph-knowledge reads an intent and records every concept it introduces in an Open Knowledge Format bundle at knowledge/. kartograph-features reads an intent and derives capabilities and Gherkin features under features/, updating what already exists.
defaultPrompt: Explore my intent for a new feature with kartograph-explore
I have a rough idea for a product change — help me write down what I actually want
Extract the concepts of my newest intent into the knowledge base with kartograph-knowledge
Derive the capabilities and features of my newest intent with kartograph-features
